news.title: Prismfall 1.0 is live
news.body: One hull. Endless light. Steer, aim and fire your way through the rift in Spectra Games' neon survival shooter.

games.title: Prismfall
games.tagline: One hull. Endless light. Survive the rift.
games.description: A neon arena survival shooter. Steer your hull, aim your prism cannon and fire by hand while you dash and harvest light shards to level up. Stay inside the red border of the rift, survive escalating swarms, and break the Prism Wraith when it breaches.
features: Hands-on tank controls: thrust, turn, aim and fire yourself
A big arena with a follow camera, and a deadly red border
Icon Kit: unlockable hull shapes and colours
Four solid enemy types and a recurring Prism Wraith boss
Fullscreen, with WebAudio synth effects and no asset files

achievements.name: Resonant
achievements.desc: Reach level 10 in a single run.

notes: Manual tank controls with a follow camera and a deadly red arena border
Four enemy types plus the Prism Wraith boss
13 escalating augmentations, including Seeker Lens homing
Main menu, Icon Kit and settings
